docs.summary: Per-area path cost overrides on top of the project's area costs (see [`NavMeshAreas`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAreas)), carried by a [`NavMeshQueryFilter`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshQueryFilter).
The cost for an area: this override, or the project default.

members.name: SetAreaCost
members.signature: public void SetAreaCost(int areaIndex, float cost)

docs.summary: Override an area's cost. Clamped to at least 1: Detour's heuristic is only admissible when nothing costs less than distance, so a lower cost silently produces worse paths. To prefer an area, raise the others instead.
